digest.component_or_area: source code comment organization and relocation across six subsystems

Three files (event_append.py, _processors.py, signing.py) retain their comments as load-bearing replay-compat and security invariants; real architectural splits identified but deferred out of scope

Six verified-stale comments corrected in place where they document live invariants (deterministic floor, Anthropic constraints, import sequencing, key maps); obsolete comments with no invariant basis are deleted
Net measured recovery across six stacked changes (1542-1547) yields ~85 recovered lines, driven by relocation to ADRs 0062-0069 rather than deletion, with no behavioral changes and full CI pass
